purpose: Exact first decision from the recorded search episode

essential:
You control chef 0. Maximize shared soup delivery points in 400 ticks.
Your fixed teammate independently collects, cooks and serves. Both act from the same public state; its next action is hidden. Thinking does not advance game time.
Tick 0; remaining 400; team score 0.0; delivered 0.
Full map cramped_room, width 5, height 4. Coordinates (x,y): origin upper-left, x right, y down.
Map legend: .=floor, X=counter, O=onion supply, T=tomato supply, D=dish supply, P=pot, S=serve.
row y=0: XXPXX
row y=1: O...O
row y=2: X...X
row y=3: XDXSX

Pot capacity: 3 ingredients.
Allowed soup: onion+onion+onion; cook 20 ticks; delivery reward 20.
Bonus orders: []; order bonus 2.
Both chefs share delivery rewards. Actions resolve together, one native tick per joint action.
A direction moves one floor tile and sets facing; blocked movement can still change facing.
Chefs cannot share a tile or swap positions in one tick. Collisions cancel their movement.
INTERACT affects the adjacent tile in the direction the chef is facing.
Empty hands take ingredients/dishes from dispensers or pick up an object from a counter.
Holding an object: INTERACT places it on an empty counter. Ingredients can be added to idle pots.
With empty hands, INTERACT with an idle pot containing ingredients to start cooking.
A dish is needed to collect ready soup; deliver the soup at S to score. Cooking uses ticks, not seconds.
All six actions are allowed; an ineffective interaction is a native no-op, not an illegal action.
The episode ends at its fixed step budget; task goals do not end the native episode early.
Recent joint actions (chef 0, chef 1) and reward:

criteria.EAST: Face east toward [2, 2]: move one floor tile.
criteria.INTERACT: Interact with [1, 1]: no useful interaction at the faced tile.
criteria.NORTH: Face north toward [1, 1]: move one floor tile.
criteria.SOUTH: Face south toward [1, 3]: turn toward the dish dispenser without moving; interact on a later tick.
criteria.STAY: Wait one tick without moving or interacting; cooking progresses.
criteria.WEST: Face west toward [0, 2]: turn toward the counter without moving; interact on a later tick.

action.instructions: Which action produces useful progress right now? Read each immediate effect. If already facing a useful supply, pot or serving station, interact now. Turning does not pick up or deliver anything. Avoid repeated blocked turns and ineffective interactions. Otherwise move toward the next ingredient, pot, dish or serving station needed for soup.
